mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it triggers hawkish monetary policy expectations that increase real interest rates and depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months with CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in residential sales indicates strong labor market conditions driving consumer spending, which together predict positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with UNRATE decline and RSAFS increase, or interaction term coefficient is insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a further decline signals labor market overheating that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months with UNRATE < 4.0% and declining UNRATE, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction (HOUST) over the past two months signals strong consumer demand and housing market activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with rising HOUST, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months with INDPRO < 105.0 for 2 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in unemployment rate indicates economic weakening with manufacturing contraction and labor market deterioration, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months with INDPRO decline and UNRATE rise, or interaction term coefficient is positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a strong consumer demand regime (RSAFS > 500000 million dollars), a further increase in residential sales signals robust economic growth that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with RSAFS > 500000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
